title: UFO spotted in Tehran? Strange lights streaking across Iran's sky spark frenzy; Watch
description: Unverified footage of glowing objects over Tehran has ignited global curiosity, with theories ranging from drones to something far more mysterious.

title: Alien or UFO Sighting? Viral Videos Show Multi-Coloured Object Over Tehran
description: Videos of a brightly lit multi-coloured object over Tehran’s night sky have gone viral on social media, sparking speculation it could be a drone, aircraft or UFO. The footage remains unverified, with no official Iranian identification. The timing coincides with the 50th anniversary of a 1976 Tehran UFO incident, amid regional tensions.

title: Historical Glasgow structure likened to 'UFO' granted B-listed status
description: Cranhill Water Tower in the East End of Glasgow has been granted listed status by Historic Environment Scotland.

title: Mysterious object over Tehran sparks UFO speculation
description: Videos of an unidentified flying object (UFO) have gone viral on social media. The footage is said to show bright lights moving across the night sky of Tehran, Iran.
